evidence: Independently examined the attached failed GitHub release artifact for pull request #46, workflow run 39690118571 and failing original Playwright trace (including the original rpg-primary-nav-layout.spec.ts source saved in trace resources). The test called openRoute(page, rpgRoutes.map), which returned after a Campaign heading appeared, then immediately measured document.documentElement.scrollHeight. The trace includes a loading-state snapshot with Loading campaign map and Loading your Hero. The failure reported documentHeight 800 for viewportHeight 800; the eventual failure screenshot and error-context snapshot show a later, loaded long map. This supports the asynchronous readiness diagnosis rather than proving a faulty page scroll behavior.

The owner supplied the complete claimed inserted test-only code: await expect(page.getByRole('list', { name: 'Campaign map nodes' })).toBeVisible() immediately following openRoute(page, rpgRoutes.map), before navigation bounding and document-height measurement. The original trace/source shows the location and surrounding checks. The earlier loaded error-context snapshot confirms Campaign map nodes is an actual named list, so it is a meaningful readiness marker rather than a fixed delay.

The exact original assertions remain present according to the owner-supplied patch and source: documentHeight > viewportHeight + 1000, actual wheel scrolling, scrollY > 1000, navigation document-coordinate invariance and scrolled navigation leaving the visible viewport. There is no skipped test, relaxed threshold, CSS change or shared openRoute helper change in the reported delta.

Owner-reported focused outcomes: 23/23 Chromium navigation-layout tests pass with one worker and zero retries; the corrected case separately passes 5/5 in one --repeat-each=5 stability run; Prettier, ESLint, typecheck and git diff --check pass. These commands were not independently executed by this reviewer. The locally reproduced failure was not observed; the trace supplied the root-cause evidence.

The owner-reported local HEAD, parent, tree and payload identities are not independently read from the owner's Git object database. The finalization preflight must verify these exact identities and that HEAD changes only e2e/rpg-primary-nav-layout.spec.ts with five added lines before authorizing an evidence-only commit or branch push.
